name: National Foods NW
old_description: Our National Food NW farms have provided the local community with the highest quality fresh eggs for over 60 years. Our values guide our everyday decisions — environmental sustainability, humane animal care, and strong stewardship in our community. Our team of dedicated employees work diligently every day to ensure that you have fresh eggs on your family’s table or for your food service needs.
about:
National Foods NW operates from Lind, Washington, with a corporate office in Everett, and has been farming eggs in the Pacific Northwest for over 60 years. The company does not disclose a precise founding year, founder names, or ownership structure in its public materials, though it markets a specialty line under the Cherry Lane Family Farms brand.

The company produces fresh shell eggs — including organic, cage-free brown and white varieties, and omega-3 enriched eggs — and runs a liquid egg processing operation under its Chef’s Select® line. It describes its output as manufacturing and food‑service products, with branded retail lines Naturally Organic®, Naturally Nested®, and Naturally Omega®. Facility size, headcount, annual volume, and SKU count are not published.

National Foods NW serves food‑service distributors, food manufacturers, and retail grocery channels. Its website cites “food service needs” and “manufacturing and food service products” as primary outlets, and the 2024 announcement of 100% cage‑free production in Washington indicates supply to regional buyers requiring that standard.

The company states that its decisions are guided by environmental sustainability, humane animal care, and strong community stewardship. Its recent cage‑free conversion, completed by the end of 2023, is presented as a direct expression of those values.
